_README: Template for a new migration run. Copy to plans/<PROJECT>.plan.json and replace every __PLACEHOLDER__. Then: bash orchestration/run.sh plans/<PROJECT>.plan.json. Placeholders: lesalondelaphoto (folder under projects/, e.g. acme), https://www.lesalondelaphoto.com/fr-FR (reference URL), lsp (CND namespace, e.g. acme), lspmix (e.g. acmemix), lesalondelaphoto (Jahia siteKey), fr (primary language, e.g. en), @orchestration/sitemaps/lesalondelaphoto.txt (comma-separated page slugs, home first), /Users/stephane/Runtimes/0.Modules/jahiaMigration (absolute path to jahiaMigration). Prereq: projects/lesalondelaphoto/.env must define JAHIA_USER, JAHIA_HOST, and JAHIA_MCP_TOKEN (gitignored). The structure mirrors plans/sial-paris.plan.json; keep the PROBE: lines verbatim.
goal: Migrate https://www.lesalondelaphoto.com/fr-FR to a Jahia JS module (project: lesalondelaphoto, namespace lsp, siteKey lesalondelaphoto, language fr). Each step is proven by its PROBE command; a step is done only when the probe exits 0.

epics.title: Foundation: connect + analyze
epics.goal: Confirm Jahia reachable and produce a complete component/content manifest.

stories.title: Analyze the reference site
stories.description: Verify connectivity, then analyze https://www.lesalondelaphoto.com/fr-FR into a manifest and content data.

steps.title: Verify Jahia connection (Gate 0)
acceptance_criteria: PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/connect.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto

steps.title: Analyze -> manifest (Gate 1: HALT)
acceptance_criteria: Use the namespace provided in inputs (lsp / lspmix) for EVERY nodeType in component-manifest.json — do NOT invent a different prefix.

Content with its own navigable URL (news/blog articles, press releases, events, products) are jmix:mainResource detail content types: needsMainResource:true with both a default (card) and fullPage view.

BROWSER-FIRST CAPTURE (anti-hallucination): if the site is JS-rendered or behind a WAF, the wget cache is only the static shell. Per .agents/skills/capture-reference/SKILL.md, capture via the browser (Chrome MCP) each page's real rendered text, the COMPLETE item list, real image URLs, and facet/taxonomy values + counts, into projects/lesalondelaphoto/.reference/captured/. Build content-data.json from this captured truth — never fabricate summaries/titles/taxonomy/images.
Write ALL 4 SKILL Step 8 outputs: analysis.md, component-manifest.json, content-data.json, asset-inventory.json.

If the source is Sitecore SXA (.component / .component-content / field-* in the cached DOM), components are DECLARED in the markup — do NOT eyeball-discover them. Per .agents/skills/sitecore-sxa/SKILL.md, run the deterministic extractor (python3 orchestration/lib/sxa-extract.py projects/

/.reference/cache > projects/

/.reference/sxa-components.json) and account for EVERY extracted component in component-manifest.json: each Jahia type carries sxaSource:[...]; deliberately-skipped generics go in a top-level sxaIgnored:[...]. No silent drops.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/sxa-coverage.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/analyze.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto
Gate 1: present section map + field splits, return status halt.

steps.title: Extract media + content from source (deterministic, agnostic)
acceptance_criteria: Migration is ETL: the captured DOM is the source of truth. Run the DETERMINISTIC extractors (source_detect + extract_media + extract_content) — do NOT hand-author or improvise the manifests; they must come from the real captured source.

Media manifest (orchestration/images/<project>.json) must cover every captured page incl. home; content-data (orchestration/content/<project>.content-data.json) must hold the REAL per-page text/instances, not placeholders.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/extract.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lesalondelaphoto

steps.title: Implement components
acceptance_criteria: Implement components ONE at a time — never batch-stub them all then build at the end. The build-time gate here is components-all.sh: it validates source-pairing + no-stub + en/fr i18n for EVERY component and builds once. NOTE: component-validate.sh additionally DEPLOYS and RENDERS a non-home page, so it only passes AFTER content/pages exist — it is a POST-CONTENT per-component debugging gate (used while iterating on a single deployed component), NOT run at this step.

Per-component completeness gate over EVERY component (loops each, FAILS naming any stubbed / unlabelled / viewless component, builds the module once): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/components-all.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lsp

steps.title: Layout + templates
acceptance_criteria: PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/templates.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto

2-3 page templates by ROLE (home/section/detail); restrict each Area with allowedNodeTypes (.agents/skills/08-page-templates): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/template-govern.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto

steps.title: Deploy (Gate 3: HALT)
acceptance_criteria: PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/deploy.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto
Render-gate the deployed shell (header/nav/footer must not be collapsed/broken): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/render-all.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lesalondelaphoto fr /home
Gate 3: present deployed shell screenshot, return status halt.

epics.title: Content + review + accessibility
epics.goal: Create + publish all content, review, accessibility audit.

stories.title: Create + publish content
stories.description: Create and publish all pages (@orchestration/sitemaps/lesalondelaphoto.txt) to live.

steps.title: Import media into the DAM (deterministic)
acceptance_criteria: Import EVERY image from the deterministic manifest (orchestration/images/<project>.json) into the DAM via orchestration/images/import.py — do not skip media. This is the 0-of-40-images fix.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/media.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lesalondelaphoto

steps.title: Create content (Gate 4: HALT)
acceptance_criteria: LOAD content from orchestration/content/<project>.content-data.json and wire imported media from orchestration/images/<project>.imported.json — do NOT improvise text or invent placeholder content (the captured source is the source of truth).

Use the Jahia MCP server (JSON-RPC at $JAHIA_HOST/modules/mcp) for ALL node creation, property edits, and publishing. GraphQL is a fallback only when the MCP cannot do it; state any fallback in the summary.

IMAGES = DAM weakreferences, NEVER url strings (AGENTS.md 2a). Import via MCP media.upload.url (consistent UUID), set the WEAKREFERENCE field (image/backgroundImage/logo/photo), clear any *ExternalUrl string. Canonical tools: orchestration/images/set_hero_refs.py and set_image_refs.py lesalondelaphoto lesalondelaphoto lsp. Capture source URLs via browser (site blocks the agent).
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/mcp.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/content.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lesalondelaphoto fr @orchestration/sitemaps/lesalondelaphoto.txt
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-url-images.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lesalondelaphoto lsp

Render-gate EACH page as you finish it (do not defer to the end). The step is not done until every page renders clean: PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/render-all.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lesalondelaphoto fr @orchestration/sitemaps/lesalondelaphoto.txt

Publish completeness: every weakref'd asset (image/logo/link/category) must resolve in LIVE and every translation must be published (publish WITH languages:[fr]): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/publish-parity.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lesalondelaphoto fr

Editability: shared regions (nav/footer/topbar) must render AND be editable in Page Builder, not blank (AbsoluteAreas need child content nodes): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/edit-frame.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lesalondelaphoto fr home

Quality: every page passes a11y (axe-core, no critical/serious) + SEO baseline (title, meta, single h1, img alt): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/site-review.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lesalondelaphoto fr @orchestration/sitemaps/lesalondelaphoto.txt

Reuse guard: content/page discovery must NOT add types beyond the approved per-project baseline (reuse a type or add a view instead): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-new-types.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lsp projects/lesalondelaphoto/component-baseline.txt
Gate 4: present reference vs Jahia screenshots, return status halt.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-graphql-writes.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto

APPROVE only if every gate is green and no critical/major finding stands.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/artifact.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto/workflow-output/review/REVIEW.md
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-stub.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lsp
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/cnd-review.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto
Reuse/views: no two types may share a property shape (consolidate into one type + views): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/dup-shapes.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lsp

Reuse guard against the FROZEN baseline (do NOT re-write it here — it was frozen at step_content_types): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-new-types.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lsp projects/lesalondelaphoto/component-baseline.txt
Gate 5: present findings, return status halt.
